content: service method ProcessSwPackage [SWS_UCM_00349] Upstream: RS_UCM_00005 , RS_UCM_00015 , RS_UCM_00026 ProcessSwPackage (IN TransferIdType id) Process a previously transferred Software Package or a partly transferred Software Package from a stream. Scope service interface PackageManagement class mono Fire & Forget false class mono Version 1.0 class mono Parameter th Name th Richtung th Typ th Beschreibung td id td IN td TransferIdType td The Transfer ID of the Software Package which should be processed. Application Errors th Fehler th Beschreibung td kOperationNotPermitted td The operation is not supported in the current context. td kServiceBusy td Another processing is already ongoing and therefore the current processing request has to be rejected. td kTransferIdInvalid td The Transfer ID is invalid. td kAuthenticationFailed td Package authentication failed. td kPackageVersionIncompatible td The version of the Software or Vehicle Package to be processed is not compatible with the current version of UCM or V-UCM. td kPackageManifestInvalid td Package manifest could not be read. td kSoftwareClusterMissing td The Software Cluster is not present in the Machine. td kDeltaIncompatible td Delta package dependency check failed. td kMemoryInsufficient td Insufficient memory to perform operation. td kChecksumDescriptionInvalid td Checksum attribute not recognised. td kProcessedSoftwarePackageInconsistent td The processed Software Package integrity check has failed. Management td kSwclRemovalDenied td Attempt to remove PLATFORM_CORE Software Cluster. td kOldVersion td Software Package version is too old. td kProcessSwPackageCanceled td The processing operation has been interrupted by a Cancel() call.
